SRC-009:R001.text: [CORE-001] git_diff.py commit/revert/delete must bind every Git mutation to the exactly verified preview snapshot and scope; no repo-wide reset --hard or clean -fd; late unrelated path excluded; late authorized-path byte change fails closed

SRC-009:R002.text: [CORE-002] parser.move_ticket and WriteCoordinator.recover must run under the authoritative ownership transaction, refusing WRITER_BUSY while an agent owns the root, and recovery must attribute self-writes

SRC-009:R003.text: [CORE-003] api.read_file_text ordinary-file snapshot must come from one byte read so text and edit_version describe the same revision

SRC-009:R004.text: [W2-001] ProcessManager.launch Popen failure must not self-deadlock the admission lock; the in-flight token retires and the manager stays usable

SRC-009:R005.text: [W2-002] SaipenWatcher topology must be lifecycle-aware on every path so a stale sync cannot republish topology across stop/revive without a live watch

SRC-009:R006.text: [W2-003] service shutdown must be a quiescence boundary: all allowlisted RPCs are admitted and drained before Api teardown; new RPCs during stopping get controlled 503

SRC-009:R007.text: [W2-004] scan liveness must be paired across success/error/cancel/overlap so a failed or cancelled scan cannot strand scanning=true

SRC-009:R008.text: [PERF-001] app.js flash registration must be O(N) and bind to the replacement DOM with the 20s fade owning the current rows
